title: 10 Best Santalum Album Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Santalum album are teas, decoctions, tinctures, essential oils, and creams, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from dried santalum album leaves are commonly used to promote relaxation and improve sleep. Decoctions, which involve boiling the bark or wood, are valued for their ability to support respiratory and digestive health. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its calming and anti-inflammatory properties. Essential oils derived from the wood are prized for their aromatic and therapeutic effects, while creams infused with santalum album are used topically to soothe skin conditions and reduce inflammation.
